shortDescription: Canada's main stock index opened higher on Thursday, boosted by mining stocks tracking higher prices of precious metals, while the US Federal Reserve's focus on fighting inflation lifted broader risk appetite.The S&P/TSX Composite Index TSX:TSX was up 1.2% at 35,907.57 at 09:31 a.m. ET.
